leagues_friends_shape.name: leagues_friends_shape
leagues_friends_shape.value: "leagues"."type" <> 'friends' or ("leagues"."invite_code" is not null and "leagues"."max_members" is not null and "leagues"."max_members" between 2 and 10)

leagues_tier_shape.name: leagues_tier_shape
leagues_tier_shape.value:
("leagues"."type"::text = 'tier') = ("leagues"."tier" is not null and "leagues"."tier_group" is not null)
        and ("leagues"."type"::text <> 'tier' or "leagues"."max_members" between 2 and 50)
        and ("leagues"."tier" is null or "leagues"."tier" in ('bronze', 'silver', 'gold', 'platinum', 'legend'))
